MP High Court reduces husband's life sentence for wife's murder

The Madhya Pradesh High Court has reduced a husband's life sentence to seven years imprisonment for murdering his wife. The court's decision came after considering the circumstances, including a statement made by the wife. The case involved a dispute that escalated to fatal violence.
